snippet.title: Brawlhalla x Guacamelee Crossover Trailer (mod)
snippet.description:
Crossover Tezca, Guacamelee's Juan Aguacate was defending his homeland when he mysteriously landed in Valhalla in our 16th crossover mod! Let us know what your dream crossovers and check end of the video on how to get the mod! Gameplay showcase out now!

Mod download: https://gamebanana.com/mods/492645

Big shoutouts to Zustos for the render work and Lord Shadow for creating the mod, support and give them a follow below! 

Zustos - https://twitter.com/Zustos_
Lord Shadow - https://twitter.com/LordShadow505

All animations are properties of Dark Screen Games and Brawlhalla, illustration by jack-tinx, go to their YouTube/Web pages to check them out!
